address: Praya Palazzo 757/1 Soi Somdet Phra Pin Klao 2, Bang Yi Khan, Bang Phlat, Bangkok, 10700, Thailand
bio: Accessible only by boat, the Praya Palazzo hotel’s Praya Dining is located in a century-old Palladian-style mansion on the banks of the Chao Phraya River. Inside, it exudes historic charm to complement its culinary offerings. The menu unites iconic dishes from the Sukhothai and Ayutthaya Kingdoms with the Rattanakosin Kingdom and modern Bangkok; Gaeng Rawang, a stir-fried beef curry flavoured with turmeric and lemongrass, stands out for its great aromatic spicing....
